name: LM Studio
tagline: LM Studio is a desktop application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that lets anyone browse, download, and run open-source language models locally without touching the command line. Its built-in chat interface works out of the box, and it also serves a local OpenAI-compatible API so existing tools like Continue, Cursor, or custom scripts can use local models. It supports the full range of GGUF-quantised models from Hugging Face, making state-of-the-art AI accessible on consumer laptops.
